Formats of certificate objects
Current version of
CryptoAPI
has minimal support of well-known cryptographic
formats encoding/decoding: support of only DER and PEM encoding for X.509
certificates and certificate signing requests is required from any implementation
of
CryptoAPI
. For other cryptographic objects an implementation can support
only "raw" formats. Following extension of the
CryptoAPI
by unified interfaces
for encoding/decoding of complex objects to standard formats is planned for the
next release of this specification.
